newsitem.title: USA: FOB GULF GRAIN-SOY OFFERS MOSTLY UP, CORN STEADY.
newsitem.headline: FOB GULF GRAIN-SOY OFFERS MOSTLY UP, CORN STEADY.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers were mostly steady to higher on Tuesday, partly supported by scant farm sales, while corn and wheat values were unchanged, dealers said.
There has been very limited selling, one dealer said, referring to soybean movement. Nearby cash prices were also firm, he said.
On the export front, Jordan bought 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter or hard red spring or optional origin wheat for October shipment at $178.80 per tonne on Tuesday, traders said.
It was also extending until Thursday the deadline for offers of another 50,000 tonnes and bringing forward the shipment period to second half October from November.
